games.embers.note: Name of the Embers game, the title of its results card.

games.echo.note: Name of the Echo game, the title of its results card.

games.play_embers.note: VoiceOver label of the flame button that starts Embers.

games.play_echo.note: VoiceOver label of the rune button that starts Echo.

games.again.note: Results card: the main button that starts another round.

games.how_to.note: Results card: quiet button that shows the rules again.

games.skip.note: Quiet button that skips the lesson of a game.

games.new_best.note: Badge on the results card when the score beats the best.

games.best.note: Results card: the best score for games with this many Imps, under the score. The imps argument is the phrase 'with 3 Imps' (games.best_imps).

games.best_imps.note: Part of the best line on the results card: how many Imps played, e.g. 'with 3 Imps'. It ends the sentence 'Best 40 with 3 Imps' (zh-Hans: starts it).

games.prize.flawless.note: Prize badge: no ember got away in the round.

games.prize.clean.note: Prize badge: no smoke was hit in the round.

games.prize.perfect_echo.note: Prize badge: Echo was played all the way to the end.

games.prize.times.note: Under a prize badge: how many rounds earned it.

games.prize.in_a_row.note: Under a prize badge: how many rounds in a row earned it.

games.stat.combo.note: Results stat: the most embers taken in one flight.

games.stat.waves.note: Results stat: waves of embers caught whole, out of all waves.

games.stat.escaped.note: Results stat: embers that rose out of the screen uncaught.

games.stat.longest.note: Results stat: the longest sequence of Echo repeated.

games.stat.slips.note: Results stat: mistakes made in Echo.
